description: This file contains utility functions for processing changelog section items, including formatting lines, filtering based on scopes, and extracting section items from a changelog version object.

methods.name: removeAnythingInParentheses
methods.description: Removes all content within parentheses from a string.

methods.name: capitalizeFirstLetter
methods.description: Capitalizes the first letter of a string.

methods.name: formatChangelogLine
methods.description: Formats a changelog line by capitalizing it and removing parentheses content.

methods.name: lineHasIgnoredScope
methods.description: Checks if a line includes any ignored scopes.

methods.name: lineHasOnlyOneWord
methods.description: Determines if a line contains only a single word.

methods.name: getSectionItems
methods.description: Retrieves and filters section items from a version object based on formatting and scope.
